status: partial -- n8n half runs live, GHL half unbuilt (no sandbox sub-account)
description: Speed-to-Lead + Booking Engine v1. Inbound (form / Messenger / missed call) -> SMS+email inside 60s, Messenger drafted for a human -> AI qualification -> booked -> reminders -> no-show recovery -> reactivation -> weekly owner report.

buildSurface.note: GHL workflows, snapshots, sub-accounts and pipelines are UI-only. The public API exposes no create-workflow, no create-snapshot, no create-location and no create-pipeline operation (re-verified 2026-08-21). Everything in workflows[] below is built by hand in the GHL UI from speed-to-lead-snapshot-v1.md, then exported as a snapshot.
buildSurface.pipelineCorrection: pipeline was listed as apiBuildable until 2026-08-21. It is not. The opportunities domain exposes exactly 5 operations -- get-pipelines, search-opportunity, create-opportunity, Upsert-opportunity, update-opportunity(+status/followers/delete) -- every one of which reads pipelines or acts on a single deal inside one. Nothing creates a pipeline. This matters because STL 1 action 4 creates an opportunity against custom_values.pipeline_id, and GHL_SANDBOX_PIPELINE_ID cannot be filled until a human makes that pipeline in the UI.
buildSurface.provisioning: automation/ghl/provision-sandbox.mjs emits the verified call plan for the apiBuildable list (29 calls). It refuses to target any production id.

configPoints.comment: Everything a new client changes. Client #2 edits only this block -- that is what makes redeploy configuration, not construction. Set as GHL Custom Values so workflow copy never hardcodes a clinic name.

customFields.name: Lead Source Detail
customFields.why: web_form | facebook | missed_call -- drives per-channel reporting

customFields.name: First Touch At
customFields.why: stamped when the first SMS/email leaves; the sub-60s proof

customFields.name: Response Seconds
customFields.why: inbound -> first touch, in seconds. The number on the weekly report.

customFields.name: Treatment Interest
customFields.why: captured by AI qualification; drives which reactivation copy is used

customFields.name: Messenger Thread Id
customFields.why: page-scoped id for the Facebook thread; the only handle a Messenger-only lead has

workflows.name: STL 1 -- First Touch (60s)
workflows.trigger: Inbound webhook / form submit / FB message / missed call
workflows.sla: SMS/email out in <60s; Messenger drafted and queued for a human inside the same 60s

workflows.name: STL 7 -- Weekly Owner Report
workflows.note: Built and tested. GHL cannot aggregate across contacts, appointments and a custom field, so this one lives in n8n rather than the snapshot.

safety.rule: No real SMS or email to a real number from a non-client account. The n8n transport node enforces this; automation/n8n/test/speed-to-lead-smoke.mjs fails the build if sandbox-sink is swapped for a live transport.
safety.verified: 2026-08-19 -- negative test confirmed the swap is caught
safety.messengerRule: Messenger is never sent automatically. Facebook does not permit it on these threads and a ban costs the client every channel at once. The engine drafts the reply and queues it with a deadline; a human sends. speed-to-lead-smoke.mjs fails if a Messenger action ever reports a send.

verification.localResult: intake: 9/9 scenarios, 11/12 nodes exercised, worst case 3 ms of a 60000 ms budget. report: every metric matched.
verification.remoteResult: FIRST RUN AGAINST LIVE n8n 2.35.3. intake: 9/9 scenarios, worst case 241 ms of a 60000 ms budget (0.4%). report: every metric matched. These are the numbers to quote -- local-mode figures prove logic only, never transport.
negativeTests: live transport swapped for sandbox-sink -> harness fails, exits non-zero (2026-08-19)
Messenger action reports delivered -> harness fails both Messenger scenarios (2026-08-19)
production GoHighLevel id hardcoded in the workflow -> harness refuses to run, names the node (2026-08-21)
foundByRemoteMode: Weekly report rendered "Your clinic -- week of this week" against live n8n while passing locally: clinic and week_of were read from $env only, and the local harness injects a fake $env the host does not have. Fixed -- payload -> env -> derived.
n8n import:workflow deactivates workflows and reports success; every webhook 404s until publish:workflow + restart. Local mode reads JSON off disk and cannot see this.

runsToday: inbound normalise across 4 shapes (web form, Facebook message, missed call, email-only)
first-touch SMS + email composed and delivered to the sandbox sink
Messenger drafted, deep-linked and queued for a human with a 60s due_by
response time measured against the 60s budget
weekly owner report aggregated and rendered
neverRun: contact upsert into any CRM (queued_for_replay, ghl_sandbox_location_unset)
snapshot restore into a second account
endToEnd.note: The Speed-to-Lead half runs and is measured. The Booking Engine half has never executed -- it is spec-complete and zero-built, because GHL workflows are UI-only and the only connected location is production. Do not read "9/9 passing" as end to end.
